detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

When something burns CPU, you open a flame graph and find the function. But when something waits on the disk the CPU profile is empty. Here's why the fix isn't off-CPU profiling: https://coroot.com/blog/disk-io-profiling-with-ebpf/

Disk I/O profiling is now out and on by default in coroot-node-agent for every process on the node, with no instrumentation and no significant overhead. (Under 2% on pgbench within noise on fio at 700k IOPS.)



#observability #monitoring #kubernetes #opensource #linux #ebpf #devops #sre #cloud
